description: Current audit UI additions, kept separate from the immutable historical capability baseline.

capabilities.name: Feature & API catalogue
capabilities.description: Open Help → Feature & API catalogue to browse and search the planner's documented features, filter by area, follow related functionality and inspect complete workflow descriptions. The guide covers the planner, member registration and room administration.
entry_points: Planner header → Help → Feature & API catalogue
user_actions: Search by feature name, description, action or identifier
Filter by area and expand a feature for requirements, rules, effects and evidence
Open Workflows to read prerequisites, state transitions and recovery paths
Close with Close or Escape and return to the header button
capabilities.preconditions: Documentation files must be available. Reading the catalogue requires no room code and grants no administrative permission.
business_rules: Display every baseline feature plus the current audit additions without changing the historical registry
Keep audit controls separate from plan state, history, saving and publishing
Report a documentation loading failure with Retry and a documentation link
side_effects: Loads public reference files and temporarily opens a modal; no plan or registration writes
known_limitations: This is reference documentation, not a live feature-health scan or a guarantee that all baseline assertions pass
coverage_gaps: Screen-reader and physical mobile-device verification remain separate from automated browser checks

capabilities.name: Swagger UI API reference
capabilities.description: Browse the shared service's HTTP endpoints, authentication requirements, request fields, schemas and responses in a read-only Swagger UI view. Download the existing OpenAPI specification for development tools.
user_actions: Filter and expand HTTP endpoints
Inspect request and response schemas
Open or download the canonical OpenAPI YAML
Choose the pinned baseline or current collaboration extension specification
capabilities.preconditions: The API tab loads its locally bundled Swagger UI assets and the public OpenAPI document. No API or admin key is needed to read it.
business_rules: Disable request execution, persisted authorization, external validation and query-string configuration overrides
Keep the OpenAPI document as the endpoint source of truth
Document browser-only operations under Features and Workflows rather than pretending they are HTTP endpoints
side_effects: Loads local reference assets only; does not call the shared service or OpenAI
known_limitations: The specification describes the pinned service contract, not a new audit of the independently deployed backend
coverage_gaps: API availability and real production credentials are intentionally not tested by this documentation viewer

capabilities.name: Weekly alliance participation
capabilities.description: Join the shared weekly session with an alliance officer code; show this week’s participants and earlier participants without claiming live presence.
entry_points: Planner header → Session & collaboration → Participants & proposals
user_actions: Join with an alliance officer code
Select an alliance to filter the roster
View all alliances
preconditions: Coordinator or officer access; alliance access enabled for officers
business_rules: Officer codes persist until revoked; participation and unlocks are week scoped
Opening a read-only archive never records current participation
side_effects: Writes additive weekly collaboration records; accepted changes use the existing shared plan and deployment publisher
known_limitations: Shared officer codes identify an alliance, not an individual person
Full proposal-flow mobile/browser verification is incomplete
coverage_gaps: Physical mobile and concurrent real-browser multi-officer sessions remain unverified

capabilities.name: Cross-alliance change proposals
capabilities.description: Draft, inspect and approve HQ coordinate or territory changes while keeping the accepted plan unchanged until approval.
entry_points: Planner header → Session & collaboration → Participants & proposals
user_actions: Start a draft and move an HQ or adjust zone corners
Enter a reason and submit
Preview, approve, decline, withdraw or apply a coordinator override
preconditions: No pending shared edits when starting a local draft
Reason, current week and accepted plan version required
business_rules: HQ owners approve proposed moves; territory proposals require all allocated alliances or an explicit coordinator override
Stale proposals need new review; decisions use version checks and cannot replay
Proposal previews do not sync or publish
side_effects: Writes additive weekly collaboration records; accepted changes use the existing shared plan and deployment publisher
known_limitations: Shared officer codes identify an alliance, not an individual person
Full proposal-flow mobile/browser verification is incomplete
coverage_gaps: Physical mobile and concurrent real-browser multi-officer sessions remain unverified

capabilities.name: Scoped shared editing unlocks
capabilities.description: Allow another alliance to move your HQs, or let the coordinator unlock territory editing for this weekly session.
entry_points: Planner header → Session & collaboration → Participants & proposals
user_actions: Toggle own-alliance HQ movement permission
Coordinator toggles shared territory editing permission
preconditions: Owner-alliance officer or coordinator for HQ permissions
Coordinator required for shared territory editing
business_rules: An unlock permits positions/geometry, not ownership changes or roster editing
Permission version is required; new weeks start locked
Server validates shared moves against footprint collisions and exclusions
side_effects: Writes additive weekly collaboration records; accepted changes use the existing shared plan and deployment publisher
known_limitations: Shared officer codes identify an alliance, not an individual person
Full proposal-flow mobile/browser verification is incomplete
coverage_gaps: Physical mobile and concurrent real-browser multi-officer sessions remain unverified

capabilities.name: Server home and weekly event orientation
capabilities.description: Open a server home page, select a listed weekly event or enter an alliance code, and always see the current server, event, authority and sync state.
entry_points: Persistent Server home / switch event action
user_actions: Browse explicitly listed events for a server
Join with an alliance officer code or link
Create a weekly event from a private draft
Coordinator lists or unlists an existing event
Continue a clearly labelled private draft
Organisers review the copied source and sharing settings before creating an event
preconditions: A valid server number from 1 to 999999
An access code is required to open an event plan; directory metadata alone grants no access
business_rules: Existing plans are never silently relabelled when browsing another server
Shared server identity is immutable; legacy events default to 759
Public listings contain metadata only and require opt-in
Coordinate outputs use the active plan’s server number
Joining is the primary guest route; creation is an organiser task with mandatory review
Public listing defaults off; changed setup/source invalidates review
Existing listed events require acknowledgement before creating a separate event
New event setup defaults to a fresh standard map; copying a private draft requires explicit selection
Starting-plan selection is shown in review and changes invalidate that review
side_effects: Reads the public directory; normal join/create actions retain existing shared-service behaviour
coverage_gaps: Full multi-officer browser acceptance remains broader than entry-screen tests
